description: Book a delivery in against an order that was sent: ADDS THE RECEIVED QUANTITIES TO REAL STOCK at the order’s outlet and updates the item cost book. This is not a note — it changes inventory. CONFIRM THE QUANTITIES WITH THE MERCHANT FIRST, item by item, and record what genuinely ARRIVED, not what was ordered — they differ, which is the whole point of receiving. Only `sent` and `partially_received` orders can be received; each item must be one that was ordered; receiving more than ordered is allowed. A short delivery leaves the order `partially_received` — receive again when the rest turns up. A CALL THAT RETURNS IS NOT PROOF EVERY ITEM LANDED — check `partialFailure`, and `stockApplied.complete` on a large delivery. IF IT FAILS, DO NOT RETRY BLINDLY: "still being received" means a previous delivery is being applied right now (get_receive_progress), and a wrong-status error means it was already fully received. Call get_purchase_order to see what actually landed before deciding anything. unitCost is what this delivery actually cost per unit — pass the invoice price if it differs from the order. When it does differ, the supplier’s stored cost is NOT updated unless you list that item in updateSupplierCostVariantIds, so ask the merchant whether the new price is the going rate or a one-off.

customFees.description: Any other named charge on the order, e.g. "Handling"

discount.description: Flat discount on the whole order, e.g. "25.00". Not with discountPercent

discountPercent.description: Discount as a percentage of the items subtotal

dutyFees.description: Duty / customs charged on the order

invoiceNumber.description: Supplier invoice number for this delivery

discount.description: Flat discount on this line, e.g. "2.00". Not with discountPercent

discountPercent.description: Discount as a percentage of this line’s goods

feePerUnit.description: Extra cost per unit on this line

quantity.description: How many, in the unit the item is sold in. May be fractional for goods sold by weight or length

unitCost.description: Cost per unit the merchant pays, e.g. "12.50". Never cents, never the selling price

variantId.description: Item id from get_supplier_items — the supplier must carry it

purchaseOrderId.description: Purchase order id from get_purchase_orders — not a PO number

receivedAt.description: ISO date the goods arrived — defaults to now

shippingFee.description: Shipping charged on the order, e.g. "18.00"

updateSupplierCostVariantIds.description: Items whose new unitCost should become the supplier’s stored cost from now on

name: hub_receive_purchase_order
title: Receive a delivery
